items.text: Meta-Pattern 1 (HIGH): substrate-vocabulary drift across surfaces — same concept named differently in DNA/storage/manifest/UI; needs SDK-boundary canonical home
Meta-Pattern 2: substrate-floor enforcement is aspirational not actual — declared floors not mechanically enforced (validators check declaration not pledge-backed reality)
Meta-Pattern 3: event-sourcing at scale needs snapshot/aggregation primitives — replaying full EconomicEvent history doesn't scale; needs periodic snapshot
Meta-Pattern 4: structural constraint debt accumulating (entry-type headroom, validator complexity, link-type proliferation)
Meta-Pattern 5: hard-cutover retirement gaps are migration landmines — removing a surface without a migration path strands data/consumers
Meta-Pattern 6: cross-DNA/cross-pillar coordination ambiguity — which DNA owns a shared concern, how cross-DNA signals coordinate
Operator-decision queue: architecture-shaping decisions (must resolve before Part D rewrite) + implementation-detail decisions (subsection-by-subsection)

Phase 3 recommendations: restructure Part D into prerequisite waves; defer Wave 2 (applications full-drafts) until Wave A lands; structural-debt track is its own conversation; Part C composability stress-test needs
